title: I Printed the Plotter Quota After They Ran Posters on My Code

parts.text: I printed the quota at 3:14 p.m. with three poster jobs I did not send. Print lead Omar said codes were atmosphere. I was thirty-three, designer, standing in a bay that made me look like I owned the roll. The log said MY CODE. The posters were his. I photographed the log, the roll, and Omar's name on the jobs. Then I left the still on the board they moderated. Omar laughed until IT asked for the photo. The jobs reversed. Omar code-dates the plotter now. A quota is only a number until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: Three posters ran on my plotter code — Part 1/1
social.description: Quota log, extra roll, a job name. IT asked for the photo. Has a code ever printed someone else's wall?
